text: GAU Library | Academic Research Outreach Menu GAU Library Academic Research Outreach Home About E-Resource OPAC KOHA Thesis & Journal Thesis Journal Personnel Contact About Home Gazipur Agricultural University Library at a Glance There is a separate building for Library having 14,418 squire feet spaces. The Library is an important organ in support and development of high quality teaching, research and outreach programs. The university library is a comprehensive and current collection of local and foreign books and journals related to agricultural and social sciences. The library includes about twenty five thousand books and is under expansion through a regular acquisition program. It is accessible to students, teachers, officers, staffs and other personnel associated with the university. The transactions of books, Internet facilities, e-journals, e-books, Thesis, CD-ROM service & photocopy service and are available in the library. An audiovisual room with modern equipment’s is attached to the library building, which is used for holding seminar, conference, workshops and thesis defense. Except on Govt. holidays, library opens at 9:00 AM and closes at 8:00 PM without any interval through Sunday to Thursday and on Saturday Library opens at 9:00 AM and closes at 5:00 PM, Friday is weekly holiday. Mission: The Library’s mission is to provide comprehensive resources and services in support of the research, teaching and learning needs of the University community. Vision: Build up a world-class Knowledge Resource Centre and provide innovative services and collections to the research, teaching and learning communities by using latest technology. Who Can Access: GAU promotes lifelong learning to its students and any member of the public not studying at this University.
